featured.name: Safe Roads
featured.summary: Real-time pothole detection that runs right in the browser. A YOLO model exported to ONNX checks the webcam, a road video or a photo, then puts every hazard on a shared map and warns you about the ones on your route.
highlights: YOLO model running in the browser with ONNX Runtime Web, no server needed
Live webcam, uploaded video and photo modes with boxes and severity
Hazard map plus route alerts for potholes close to your path

featured.name: AirPulse
featured.summary: A live air quality and weather monitor for Indian cities. It works out the official CPCB AQI from pollutant readings, forecasts PM2.5 with a model I trained, and alerts you when your city crosses a limit.
highlights: CPCB National AQI calculated in code with the dominant pollutant
PM2.5 forecast model compared with the CAMS forecast
City map, rankings, comparisons and threshold alerts

featured.name: NiftyLens
featured.summary: A real-time NSE dashboard for NIFTY 50 stocks. Prices, charts and technicals sit next to news headlines scored by my own sentiment model, with alerts for price moves and turning sentiment.
highlights: Near real-time prices through a small cached serverless proxy
Headline sentiment from an NLP model trained on financial news
Watchlist, technical indicators and price / sentiment alerts

others.name: Customer Churn Prediction
others.summary: Churn model on 7,043 telecom customers with a what-if risk simulator in the browser and a Flask API.

others.name: Retail Sales Analytics
others.summary: 1.07M retail transactions cleaned into SQLite, 12 SQL analyses (RFM, cohorts) and a Power BI style dashboard.
highlights: Top 20% of customers bring 77% of revenue

others.name: AP Rainfall & Crop Analysis
others.summary: 117 years of IMD rainfall and district crop data for Andhra Pradesh, told as a scrolling data story.
highlights: Rain-fed groundnut yield tracks the monsoon (r = 0.77)

others.name: Stalytex
others.summary: Analytics workspace in the browser: upload CSV or Excel, clean it, see column stats, build charts and run SQL.
highlights: In-browser SQL with sql.js, no backend
